headlines.title: Meta Rises 4% as Muse Spark 1.3 Claims Parity With Anthropic and OpenAI
headlines.summary: The AI model race got a fresh salvo this morning, and it came from Menlo Park. Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) is claiming performance parity with the top private frontier labs, and buyers are showing up in size. Meta Platforms stock is up 4% to $614.

headlines.title: PG&E, Google, Rewiring America Launch VPP in California
headlines.summary: California utility Pacific Gas and Electric (PG&E) on September 3 announced SHARE (Smart Home Assets for Reliability and Efficiency), a first-of-its-kind virtual power plant designed to help communities benefit from rising electric demand, while improving affordability and reliability for all customers.

headlines.title: Eos Energy Enterprises (EOSE) Is Up 8.1% After Google-Backed Long-Duration Storage Debut in West Virginia
headlines.summary: MN8 Energy recently announced it will collaborate with Eos Energy Enterprises and Google on a West Virginia project combining 86 MW of solar with both zinc-based long-duration and lithium-ion storage to supply clean, dispatchable power to the PJM grid and nearby data centers.

headlines.title: Innovate Canada Connects Global Event Leaders with Canada's Technology Ecosystem
headlines.summary: From September 8 to 10, 2026, Destination Canada will bring a select group of senior international association and corporate leaders to Québec City for Innovate Canada, an invitation-only program built around a simple idea: where an event takes place can shape what that event makes possible.

headlines.title: AVGO Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Rise on Strong AI Demand
headlines.summary: Broadcom's fiscal Q3 earnings and revenues beat estimates as AI chip demand surges, with AI semiconductor sales up 221% and a higher fiscal 2026 outlook.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
